steps.say: Finding one learner among all of them starts above the list: type part of their name in the search box, or narrow by class, belt or health.
Their row already carries their belt, their hours this week and when they were last here, so you can often answer the question without opening anything.

**View** opens what that learner has actually done. Health is worked out from their last visit and how they sit against their own class, so a learner marked as needing attention has gone quiet or fallen behind the people beside them.
steps.terminal: That's one learner found and read — search, row, then View. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
